Debts.pageDesc: Credit cards and loans — what you owe, at a glance.
Debts.noDebtWalletsDesc: Add a debt wallet for a credit card or loan to track what you owe and pay it down over time.
Debts.tip: Tip: an {expense} on a debt wallet increases what you owe (e.g. a credit card purchase); use {clearDebt} on a wallet's page to pay it down. Once it's fully paid off, the wallet drops off the Wallets page — its history stays visible here.

Savings.pageDesc: Money set aside, growing quietly in the background.
Savings.noSavingsWalletsDesc: Create a savings wallet, then transfer money into it to start building a cushion.
Savings.tip: Tip: record a {transfer} from a cash or bank wallet into a savings wallet to move money into savings — its balance updates automatically.

Lend.pageDesc: Money you've lent to others — what's still owed back to you.
Lend.noLendWalletsDesc: Add a lend wallet when you lend money to someone, then track it here until they pay you back.
Lend.tip: Tip: pick Lend as the category on an {expense} (or transfer money in directly) when you hand money to someone; use {getRepaid} on the wallet's page when they pay it back. Once it's fully repaid, the wallet drops off the Wallets page — its history stays visible here.

Settings.pageDesc: Your account, and the AI provider used to scan receipts.
Settings.llmSectionDesc: Choose an AI provider and paste your own API key to scan bazar lists and receipts into expenses.
Settings.googleFreeTierNotice: Gemini's free tier needs no billing setup, but Google may use free-tier prompts (including your receipt photos) to improve their products. The paid tier doesn't do this.
Settings.apiKeyPlaceholderConnected: Connected — paste a new key to replace it
Settings.howToGetKeyToggle: How do I get a {provider} key?
Settings.claudeStep1: Go to <link>console.anthropic.com</link> and sign up or sign in — a phone number is required to verify the account.
Settings.claudeStep2: Open Settings → Billing and add a card or prepay some credit. Claude's API has no lasting free tier, so a brand-new key won't work until this is done.
Settings.claudeStep3: Open <link>API Keys</link>, click "Create Key", name it, then copy it right away — it's only shown once.
Settings.claudeQuotaNote: Credits are prepaid and don't refill on their own. If a key starts failing with a low-balance error, add more funds at <link>console.anthropic.com</link>, or switch to a key that still has credit.
Settings.openaiStep1: Go to <link>platform.openai.com</link> and sign up or sign in — a phone number is required to verify the account.
Settings.openaiStep2: Open Settings → Billing and add a payment method. Like Claude, a brand-new key can't make any requests until this is done.
Settings.openaiStep3: Open <link>API keys</link>, click "Create new secret key", name it, then copy it right away — it's only shown once.
Settings.openaiQuotaNote: Credits don't refill on their own either. If a key reports "insufficient quota" or "no credits remaining", add funds at <link>platform.openai.com</link>, or switch to a key that still has credit.
Settings.googleStep1: Go to <link>aistudio.google.com</link> and sign in with a Google account — no phone number or card needed for the free tier (accounts in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland must enable billing, but free-tier usage still isn't charged).
Settings.googleStep2: Click "Get API key" in the left panel, then "Create API key".
Settings.googleStep3: Choose "Create key in a new project" — Google sets one up automatically.
Settings.googleStep4: Copy the key and paste it below.
Settings.googleQuotaNote: The free tier has a per-minute and a per-day request limit that resets on its own. A "rate limited" error usually just means waiting — a minute for the per-minute limit, or until the next day for the daily one — fixes it without needing a new key.

Landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to keep track
Landing.featuresSubtitle: One place for every wallet, transaction and budget.

wallets.title: A wallet for every kind of money
wallets.desc: Cash, bank, savings, lending and debt wallets, each with its own balance. A card's balance is what you owe; a lend wallet's is what you're owed.

transactions.title: Every expense, income and transfer
transactions.desc: Log what you spend and earn, or move money between wallets. Search and filter by month, category, wallet and date.

budgets.title: Budgets that show where you stand
budgets.desc: Set a monthly limit for each category and see spending against it at a glance, with a clear over-budget state.

spending.title: Savings, lending and debt in one place
spending.desc: Putting money into savings, lending it out and paying off a debt all count as spending in the month they happen, so your totals stay honest.

compare.title: Compare any two months
compare.desc: Line two months up side by side, category by category, and see exactly what changed.

languages.title: English and বাংলা
languages.desc: Use the whole app in English or Bangla, with native numerals, dates and ৳ amounts.

receipt.title: Scan receipts with AI
receipt.desc: Photograph a bazar list or receipt and get your expenses sorted by category, ready to review and confirm.

dashboard.title: A dashboard that tells the story
dashboard.desc: Net worth, monthly expenses, savings, budget progress and a spending-by-category chart, all on one screen.

filters.title: Browse any month, fast
filters.desc: Step through your history month by month, or search and filter by type, category, wallet and date.

calculator.title: A calculator that follows you
calculator.desc: Open a draggable calculator from any page to work out a split or a total without leaving the app.

security.title: Private and secure
security.desc: Your data is only ever yours. Sign in with email or Google, with email verification and password reset built in.

updates.title: Shaped by you
updates.desc: See every release in What's new, and suggest or vote on the features you want next.

one.title: Set up your wallets
one.desc: Create an account and start with cash, bank, savings and card wallets. Add more any time.

two.title: Log as you go — or just scan
two.desc: Add expenses, income and transfers in a few taps, or photograph a receipt and let AI fill it in. Balances update instantly.

three.title: See the full picture
three.desc: Watch net worth, monthly spending and budgets on one dashboard.

free.a: Yes. Creating an account and using every feature is free.

currency.a: Wallets default to Bangladeshi taka (৳), shown with Bangla numerals when you use the Bangla interface.

privacy.a: Your wallets and transactions belong to your account and are never shown to other users. The team only sees totals such as how many accounts exist — never your balances or transactions.

signIn.a: With your email and password (we email you a link to confirm your address) or with your Google account.

lending.q: Can I track money I've lent or debts I owe?
lending.a: Yes. Lending and debt wallets track what you're owed and what you owe. Paying off a debt or lending money out counts as spending in the month it happens.

ai.a: Take or upload a photo, and an AI model (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini — your choice, with your own API key) reads the items and sorts them into categories. You review and edit the result before anything is saved. The photo itself is never stored.

devices.q: Does it work well on my phone?
devices.a: Yes. Extrack is built for small screens too, and the receipt scanner opens full screen on phones with a flashlight button where your device supports it.

Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to see where your money goes?
Landing.ctaDesc: Create a free account in under a minute.

receipt.title: Snap a receipt. Get your expenses.
receipt.desc: Stop typing every item by hand. Take a photo or upload one, and Extrack reads it for you.
points: Scan with your camera or pick a photo from your gallery — with a preview so you can retake a blurry shot.
Items are grouped into the right categories automatically, with each category's description listing what you bought.
Review and edit everything before it's saved. Save one expense per category, or one per item.
Bring your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini key — Gemini works free. Your key is encrypted and your receipt photo is never stored.
